en.detail:
### What is 0x10AI?

0x10AI is an AI‑driven platform that aggregates ### over 200,000 AI models across ### 200+ categories, offering everything from advanced text generation (ChatGPT, GPT‑4o) to cutting‑edge image creation (DALL·E 3). Whether you need document analysis, creative image synthesis, or specialized AI tools for work and study, 0x10AI provides a one‑stop hub that eliminates the hassle of searching multiple sites.

### Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| ### Massive AI Library | More than ### 1,000 AI services and ### 200,000 GPT models covering business, education, entertainment, and daily life. |
| ### Easy Discovery | Intuitive categorization and powerful search let you find the right tool in seconds. |
| ### Free AI Submission | Developers can submit their own AI tools for free, expanding the ecosystem. |
| ### Daily Free Usage | Every user gets ### 20 free GPT‑4o calls and ### unlimited DALL·E 3 image generations each day. |
| ### Privacy‑First | User data is never used for training; you can delete your account and all data at any time. |
| ### Subscription Benefits | Unlimited GPT‑4o access, priority support, and early‑access to new AI releases. |

### How to Use 0x10AI

1. ### Create an Account – Sign up with email or social login.  
2. ### Explore the Dashboard – Browse categories or use the search bar to locate a specific AI tool.  
3. ### Start a Free Session – Click “Use GPT‑4o” for up to 20 free queries per day, or “Generate Image” with DALL·E 3.  
4. ### Upgrade if Needed – If you exceed the free limits, choose a subscription plan for unlimited usage.  
5. ### Manage Your Data – Access the privacy settings to view, export, or delete your data at any time.

### Pricing

| Plan | Daily Free Limit | Unlimited Access | Price (USD) |
|------|------------------|------------------|-------------|
| ### Free | 20 GPT‑4o calls, unlimited DALL·E 3 | No | $0 |
| ### Basic | Unlimited GPT‑4o, priority queue | Yes | $9.99 / month |
| ### Pro | Unlimited GPT‑4o + advanced API, early‑beta tools | Yes | $24.99 / month |
| ### Enterprise | Custom usage caps, dedicated account manager, SLA | Yes | Contact sales |

All plans include ### ad‑free experience, ### priority support, and ### regular updates.

### Helpful Tips

- ### Batch Queries: Combine related questions into a single GPT‑4o prompt to maximize the 20‑free‑call limit.  
- ### Prompt Engineering: Use clear, specific instructions for better image results with DALL·E 3.  
- ### Bookmark Favorites: Save frequently used AI tools to your personal dashboard for one‑click access.  
- ### Stay Updated: Subscribe to the 0x10AI newsletter for new model releases and exclusive discounts.  
- ### Leverage Community: Join the 0x10AI forum to share prompts, get feedback, and discover hidden gems.

### Frequently Asked Questions

### Q1: Can I use 0x10AI without a subscription?  
A: Yes. The free tier provides 20 GPT‑4o calls and unlimited DALL·E 3 image generations each day.

### Q2: How many AI models are available?  
A: Over ### 200,000 GPT models and ### 1,000+ AI tools across more than ### 200 categories.

### Q3: Is my data used to train the AI?  
A: No. 0x10AI respects privacy; your data is never used for training. You can delete your account anytime.

### Q4: How does the free image generation work?  
A: DALL·E 3 is fully accessible for free. Each generated image shares the same credit pool as GPT‑4o, allowing seamless creative workflows.

### Q5: What if I need more than 20 GPT‑4o calls per day?  
A: Upgrade to the Basic or Pro plan for unlimited GPT‑4o usage and additional benefits.

### Q6: Can developers submit their own AI tools?  
A: Absolutely. 0x10AI offers a free submission portal for developers to list their AI services.

### Q7: Is there a trial for the paid plans?  
A: Yes, a 7‑day risk‑free trial is available for both Basic and Pro plans. Cancel anytime before the trial ends.
